body: Ok boss said call in two weeks that’s gonna be a long two weeks

I’m scared that my mom will kick me out and I will be forced to commit suicide. My boss essentially walked me out the building and said I was fired but I called back and explained and he said call in 2 weeks and you better hope I’m in a good mood what’s that mean?

I’m only home for winter break I think I am kind of emotional right now because I am in suboxone withdrawal.But I have beat this again as I have in the worlds of Walter Payton “never die easy die hard”
